title: Liquidity Risk and Expected Stock Returns
one_line: Stocks more sensitive to aggregate liquidity (measured by daily return reversals relative to signed volume) earn ~7.5%/yr more than low-sensitivity stocks (1966-1999); market-wide liquidity drops sharply in crises.

findings.statement: Liquidity measure = order-flow-induced reversal, computable from index data.

reported_results.headline: Stocks more sensitive to aggregate liquidity (measured by daily return reversals relative to signed volume) earn ~7.5%/yr more than low-sensitivity stocks (1966-1999); market-wide liquidity drops sharply in crises.

tradable_edge: No ES strategy; its reversal-based liquidity measure could replace the range/volume ILLIQ proxy in liquidity_recovery_long_es as a variant.
data_fit: ES 1-min Dec 2013 → Sep 2026, NQ 1-min Jul 2021 → Sep 2026 (2024+ protected).
